Stage 1

Free access

See the restoration potential across your entire region

Satellite-derived identification of high potential areas

We screen your entire region of interest from space and give every point a restoration potential score from 0% to 100%. The score is built from 5–10 years of satellite imagery and scientific datasets and uses a research-backed AI model that considers 23 different environmental predictors of mangrove suitability.

23 Environmental factors
0% – 100% Scored, not simple pass-fail
10x10 m Resolution, full area

Ready to plant? Upgrade to our high-resolution products

Stage 2

From candidate areas to sites

High-resolution mapping · 30x30 cm

Using high resolution satellite imagery (down to 30x30cm GSD), our proprietary land cover and habitat classification AI models, and tidal regime and wave exposure analysis, we identify the exact sites available and suitable for planting and seeding, as well as reference and donor sites.

Output: high res RGB & MSP orthomosaics, land cover and habitat maps, full site analysis report

Stage 3

Final site selection and field validation

Drone & field surveys  ·  Ecology validation

Combination of ultra-high resolution drone and field surveys that confirm soil, water, environmental conditions match what’s been modeled. All outputs reviewed by our in-house ecology team. A report that tells you which areas you can confidently restore, the baseline conditions, and how to monitor the outcomes.

Output: Ecology-validated seeding and planting polygons, final restoration management and monitoring report.

Frequently asked questions
